title: news service install
description: Register the Bureau service under the user's own account (ADR 0007 decision 12). Karthik runs it in his own terminal: it re-launches elevated, asks for his Windows password at a prompt that does not echo, grants 'Log on as a service', creates or updates the service, and adds Board's log-on entry. `--dry-run` prints the plan and changes nothing. It is Windows administration, not a Hotline action.
